product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native platform that lets enterprise supply-chain teams combine data, optimization, forecasting and configurable workflows to build and operate supply-chain decision applications.

pricing_page.notes: No public plans or pricing page found; commercial inquiries are directed to a demo.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 323 employees and a 201–500 company-size band.

founded_year.notes: The official company information page explicitly dates founding to 2021.

eng_blog.notes: Technical practitioners describe proprietary parallel solving and cloud architecture, and learned model-predictive control for supply planning.

public_docs.notes: The documentation endpoint presents only a documentation-access screen, not several publicly readable articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI / GTM Engineer is open; the role builds and ships production AI tools and agents rather than selling AI products.

model_provider.notes: Lyric explicitly says it brings together TimesFM and Amazon Chronos, with optional fine-tuning on customer data.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type 2 attestation and ISO/IEC 27001 certification are explicit. GDPR is listed as a compliance claim/alignment, not a separate certification.

last_funding.notes: The company announcement is dated August 5, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2025 round falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Account Executive posting is available.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 product article describes the new agentic demand-forecasting capability: agents incorporate written customer context into forecasting. It is a feature announcement rather than a formal launch press release.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sean Zonneveld’s profile lists EVP Global Sales at Lyric starting May 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Applied AI / GTM Engineer posting explicitly identifies Salesforce and Fathom as part of the company’s GTM technology stack.
